name: acli
description: Claude Code skills and hooks for Jira — manage work items, sprints, and search via the Atlassian CLI (acli) without leaving your terminal

skills.name: acli-auth
skills.description: Login, logout, check status, or switch Jira and Confluence accounts

skills.name: acli-search
skills.description: Search work items by JQL, list projects, boards, filters, and dashboards

skills.name: acli-sprint
skills.description: List, create, and update sprints; show work items in a sprint

skills.name: acli-workitem
skills.description: Create, view, edit, transition, assign, comment, link, or clone issues

hooks.name: acli-auth-guard
hooks.description: Detects auth errors in acli output and injects context prompting Claude to offer re-authentication

features: Manage Jira work items (create, view, edit, transition, assign, comment, link, clone)
Auto-detect and recover from authentication failures

integrations.name: plan-realisation-fe
integrations.description: Fetches Jira ticket context from branch name or argument to inform plan generation
integrations.usage: Detects ticket keys (e.g., PV2-12493) and enriches plan documents with ticket metadata
